name: 46034 · Cicero, IN
findings: ZIP 46034 (Cicero) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46034 (Cicero) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46034 (Cicero) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).
